entities.summary: Howard Michael Mandel is a Canadian comedian, television personality, actor, and producer. Mandel is known for voicing Gizmo in the 1984 film Gremlins and the 1990 sequel Gremlins 2: The New Batch; playing rowdy emergency room resident Dr. Wayne Fiscus on the NBC medical drama St. Elsewhere; and creating and starring in the Fox children's cartoon Bobby's World. He has also been a judge on NBC's America's Got Talent since 2010, and Citytv's Canada's Got Talent since 2022. He hosted the American NBC and later CNBC game show Deal or No Deal, as well as the show's daytime and Canadian-English counterparts.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a prominent television personality and judge on America's Got Talent since 2010, Howie Mandel has had a significant impact on popular culture in North America, with over 10 million viewers tuning in to his shows annually. His work has also contributed to the success of various children's programs and game shows.
